# Newton Lab coding guidance

- Keep changes small, focused, and consistent with the existing package layout.
- Preserve user work; do not delete or reorganize unrelated files.
- Add type hints to public functions and document non-obvious assumptions.
- Add deterministic tests for behavior and edge cases; run relevant checks.
- Update documentation when behavior, setup, or scientific assumptions change.
- Separate established physical results, mathematical analogies, hypotheses,
  and experimentally supported findings. Do not overstate evidence.
- Make random seeds controllable and report uncertainty where relevant.
- Do not add secrets, machine-specific paths, or unrequested external services.
- Keep trading research offline and evidence-based; never claim profitability
  without rigorous evidence.
